origin.description: Pairs column names with collectors. The default is a guess.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Pairs column names with collectors. The default is a guess.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
spec <- cols(a = col_double(), b = col_character())
paste(c(paste(names(spec$cols), vapply(spec$cols, function(col) class(col)[1], ""), sep = "="), class(spec$default)[1]), collapse = ";")

translation.description: Pairs column names with collectors. The default is a guess.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Pairs column names with collectors. The default is a guess.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
spec = cols(a=col_double(), b=col_character())
paired = ";".join(collector.fields["name"] + "=collector_" + collector.kind for collector in spec.cols)
return paired + ";collector_" + spec.default.kind
